messages.subject: D-RUG this Tuesday
messages.body_plain:
Hi D-RUGgies!

We will be meeting this Tuesday (3/3) from 10-noon virtually and in person in the DataLab classroom (Library 360). This is a group working session so come with your questions for our expeRts, or just bring your laptop and get in some distraction free R-coding time. Additionally, if there are topics you would like to see someone do a deeper dive on, let us know!

D-RUG: 10am-noon, DataLab Classroom, Library 360, and zoom https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators

messages.subject: Workshop next week for remote computing
messages.subject_clean: Workshop next week for remote computing
messages.body_plain:
Hi D-RUGgies!

Next week Datalab is presenting a free workshop that will teach you how to use remote computing in your research. This means you’ll be able to use the University’s High Performance Computing resources like Hive or Farm or Franklin (https://hpc.ucdavis.edu/). If you work with the medical campus, these are the tools to use the Advanced Computing Environment (ACE, https://health.ucdavis.edu/data/hc2.html)

The workshop is all day Tuesday and Wednesday. Registration and more info at: https://events.library.ucdavis.edu/event/introduction-to-remote-computing-and-hpc-2026 <https://events.library.ucdavis.edu/event/introduction-to-remote-computing-and-hpc-2026?utm_campaign=widget&utm_medium=widget&utm_source=UC+Davis+Library+Events>

I hope to see you there!
-Wes
